    r."number_of_stars",
    c."fullname"
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "customers" c ON r."customerid" = c."customerid";
328:
SELECT
    r."reviewid",
    r."customer_reviews",
    r."number_of_stars",
    r."date_of_review",
    c."customerid",
    c."fullname",
    c."emailaddress",
    c."phonenumber",
    h."hotelid",
    h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "customers" c ON r."customerid" = c."customerid"
LEFT JOIN "hotels" h ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
ORDER BY r."date_of_review" DESC NULLS LAST;
329:
SELECT h."opening_year"
FROM "hotels" h
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
WHERE r."rate" = (SELECT MAX("rate") FROM "rooms")
LIMIT 1;
330:
SELECT DISTINCT
    h."opening_year",
    h."opening_month"
FROM "hotels" h
LEFT JOIN "rooms" r ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
WHERE LOWER(h."name") LIKE '%sea view%'
   OR LOWER(h."address") LIKE '%sea view%'
   OR LOWER(r."type") LIKE '%sea view%'
331:
SELECT
    j."title"        AS vacancy_title,
    d."degree_level" AS degree_level,
    d."certification" AS certification
FROM "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN "degrees" d
    ON d."job_post" = j."title"
ORDER BY j."title", d."degree_level", d."certification";
332:

    h."opening_year",
    h."opening_month"
FROM "hotels" AS h
JOIN "rooms" AS r ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
WHERE r."rate" = (
    
    SELECT MAX("rate") FROM "rooms"
)

333:
SELECT h."opening_month"
FROM "hotels" h
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
WHERE r."rate" = (SELECT MAX("rate") FROM "rooms")
LIMIT 1;
334:
SELECT
    c."fullname"            AS customer_name,
    h."name"                AS hotel_name,
    r."number_of_stars"     AS stars,
    r."customer_reviews"    AS review_text,
    r."date_of_review"      AS review_date
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "hotels" h    ON h."hotelid"    = r."hotelid"
JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = r."customerid"
ORDER BY h."name", r."date_of_review" DESC NULLS LAST;

    h."fees",
